title: Deep learning segments and risk-stratifies gastrointestinal stromal tumors on ultrasound
summary: Five segmentation networks and a ResNet18 classifier were compared on 980 ultrasound images from 245 GIST patients; the SegNeXt-ResNet18 pair performed best. On the internal test set Dice was 90.2% and risk-prediction AUC 92.0%; on 188 images from 47 prospectively collected patients Dice was 89.5% and AUC 92.5%.
ai_technology: Two-stage SegNeXt segmentation and ResNet18 classification on ultrasound images

evidence.tested: Internal test set and a prospective set of 47 patients.
evidence.unknown: Small external set; retrospective training; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Network segments tumors and classifies risk.
